Monthly clinical trial budget burn, milestone progress, and CRO vendor expenditures across four global drug development programs, 2023-2024

The Global Clinical Operations and Finance portfolio office at Aethelgard Biopharma gathered monthly expenditure and milestone execution data from 2023 through 2024 to evaluate contract research organization (CRO) vendor performance, monitor study budget burn rates against clinical milestone progression, and identify cost-per-patient variances across active clinical development pipelines.

| Column | Kind | Declared as |

| `cost_category` | category | Site Payments, CRO Management, Patient Recruitment, Laboratory & Bioanalytics, Regulatory & Monitoring; group cost |
| `cost_per_patient` | measure | unit USD; non-additive |
| `cro_vendor` | category | IQVIA Bio, Parexel Int, Icon Clinical, Fortrea; group vendor |
| `milestone_completion_pct` | measure | unit percent; non-additive |
| `report_month` | time | 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `spend_thousands` | measure | unit USD thousands; additive |
| `study` | category | Study-ONC-301, Study-IMM-204, Study-NEU-102, Study-CV-405; group trial |
| `trial_phase_stage` | category | Site Activation, First Patient In, 50% Enrolled, Last Patient In, Database Lock; ordered=stage; group milestone |
